scope: Tests only; existing default fixture delegates to the same implementation with its original generator controller ID. No public API or production change.

coverage_limits: Both trust_digest and authentication_digest change, so this is a complete current trust/authentication identity-substitution regression; it does not isolate trust_digest equality alone.
The fixture tests valid host-owned trust changes. It does not provide production trust-distribution, revocation, provider, physical effect or restart evidence.
